bead.title: Wire shared commit-transition decline scenario into objectlog suite
bead.description:
PROBLEM
The shared commit-transition scenario from governing artifact/dependency pqueue-c42136f3 is not invoked by objectlog, so objectlog decline behavior remains covered only by bespoke capability tests instead of the shared conformance contract.

ROOT CAUSE
crates/pqueue-objectlog/tests/conformance.rs:16 invokes the eventual-apply suite without the new shared commit-transition decline scenario. crates/pqueue-objectlog/tests/hot_projection_queries.rs:102 contains bespoke decline coverage that is not yet redundant with a shared harness invocation.

PROPOSED FIX
Invoke the pqueue-c42136f3 shared commit-transition scenario from the objectlog conformance entry point or equivalent invocation site for ObjectLogBackend, preserving the temp-directory isolation pattern in crates/pqueue-objectlog/tests/conformance.rs. The scenario must exercise the decline path for objectlog.

NON-SCOPE
Do not implement real CommitTransitionPort behavior for postgres/objectlog; that is a separate epic. Do not convert objectlog from decline path to positive path. Do not remove pqueue-0ef6807b bespoke decline tests until the shared harness decline path is wired and a cleanup bead proves redundancy. Preserve objectlog durability, reconnect, group-commit, and S3 substrate behavior outside this conformance invocation.

DEPENDENCIES
Requires pqueue-c42136f3. Parent: pqueue-54039317.
bead.acceptance:
1. TestObjectlogCommitTransitionDecline: `cargo test -p pqueue-objectlog --test conformance --all-features commit_transition` runs the shared decline scenario against ObjectLogBackend and passes.
2. TestObjectlogTempIsolation: repeated objectlog shared decline runs use fresh temp roots and do not share durable state between scenarios.
3. TestCargoWorkspaceGate: `cargo test --workspace --all-targets --all-features` passes.
4. TestGoWorkspaceGate: `go test ./...` passes or is documented as not applicable because the repository has no Go packages.
5. TestLefthookGate: `lefthook run pre-commit` passes.
6. TestRustStyleGate: `cargo fmt --check` and `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings` pass.
